product_family: Linguee is a free, ad-supported online dictionary and translation memory search engine. It provides bilingual example sentences for language learning and reference. Linguee is not a commercial translation service; it is owned by DeepL SE (also the operator of DeepL Translator, a paid enterprise translation API).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No SOC 2 certification found on Linguee's own domain or privacy pages. SOC 2 Type II is held by parent company DeepL SE for DeepL Translator (paid product), not for the free Linguee dictionary.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 certification found on Linguee's own domain. ISO 27001 is held by parent company DeepL SE for enterprise products (DeepL Translator), not documented for the free Linguee dictionary.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: DeepL collects and uses your personal data exclusively within the framework of the statutory provisions, in particular the General Data Protection Regulation. Processing relies on legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) and explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a)).

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA compliance mentioned on Linguee privacy policy or pages. HIPAA applies to parent company DeepL SE's enterprise translation products (DeepL Translator), not the free dictionary.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS compliance for Linguee dictionary.

certifications.name: BSI C5 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No BSI C5 Type 2 attestation found on Linguee pages. This certification applies to parent company DeepL SE's enterprise products, not the free Linguee dictionary.

privacy.ai_training_note: Linguee is a translation dictionary and memory search tool, not an AI translation service. DeepL Translator (paid product) may use data for training with customer consent controls; Linguee dictionary does not perform model training, it simply searches a static corpus of parallel sentences.

security.name: Data protection measures
security.value: Data secured against accidental or deliberate manipulation through technical and organizational safeguards continuously improved with technological developments

security.name: IP address logging
security.value: Full IP addresses retained maximum 14 days

security.name: Third-party processors
security.value: Zendesk (ticket system) for customer support; advertising partners set cookies. Zendesk may transfer data to USA.

products.name: Linguee Dictionary
products.data_scope: Search queries, IP addresses, browser metadata, cookies for ad personalization and analytics
products.notes: Free, ad-supported online dictionary. Not an AI translation model; it provides bilingual example sentences and usage context from a static translation memory corpus. Users retain IP anonymization after 14 days.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free dictionary with ads; no premium version

flags: Linguee (free dictionary) is a distinct product from DeepL Translator (paid translation API). Parent company DeepL SE holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and BSI C5 Type 2 certifications, but these apply to DeepL Translator, not the free Linguee dictionary.
Marketing or third-party sources may conflate parent company certifications with Linguee product scope. No evidence that the Linguee dictionary inherits or requires these enterprise certifications.
No dedicated trust center or security page for Linguee product. All compliance documentation references parent company DeepL SE.
Linguee is a simple dictionary search tool, not an AI model. It does not train on user data. Maturity is 'startup' because Linguee generates ad revenue only; it is not a commercial SaaS product.
GDPR compliance is explicitly stated, but no independent verification (audit, certification document) is available on Linguee domain.
